title: Educt
summary: E'DUCT, noun [Latin eductum, from educo.] Extracted matter; that which is educed; that which is brought to light, by separation, analysis or decomposition. We must consider the educts of its analysis

inlines.v: E'DUCT, noun [Latin eductum, from educo.] Extracted matter; that which is educed; that which is brought to light, by separation, analysis or decomposition. We must consider the educts of its analysis by Bergman, etc.
